maddeler.e:
نتوازن (form VI)
# نَتَوَازَنُ (natawāzanu) /na.ta.waː.za.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَازَنَ (tawāzana)
# نَتَوَازَنَ (natawāzana) /na.ta.waː.za.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَازَنَ (tawāzana)
# نَتَوَازَنْ (natawāzan) /na.ta.waː.zan/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَازَنَ (tawāzana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
